event.location_text: 新加坡海峡（新加坡水域）

sources.title: Piracy monthly report July 2025
sources.text: Duty crew onboard the tanker underway, observed three perpetrators in a craft approaching from the stern. Alarm raised and searchlight directed towards the boat resulting in the boat aborting the attempted approach. Incident reported to VTIS and a patrol vessel responded and followed the tanker for a while.
